# Vermont Junk

> Vermont Junk (Vermont Junk LLC) is a woman-owned, family-run junk removal, estate cleanout and light demolition company based in Bondville (Winhall), Vermont, serving 28 towns across Southern Vermont. Guarantee: on time, or $100 off. Phone: 1-888-802-JUNK ((888) 802-5865). Email: info@vermontjunk.com.

## Key facts
- Legal name: Vermont Junk LLC
- Based in: Bondville (Winhall), VT 05340 — service-area business
- Ownership: woman-owned and family-run (Adam & Lindsay)
- Guarantee: if the crew is late for the arrival window, the customer gets $100 off
- Credentials: insured incl. workers' compensation; USDOT #7245571
- Pricing: base rates shown are "from $X and up"; final price confirmed before work starts; disposal fees included
- Disposal: donation (e.g. Habitat for Humanity ReStore) and recycling before landfill
- Booking: call or text 1-888-802-JUNK, or https://www.vermontjunk.com/contact/

## Base rates (from $X and up)
- Single large items (sofa, freezer, piano, appliance): from $230 and up
- Garage cleanouts: from $800 and up
- Basement cleanouts: from $1,400 and up
- Whole-house and estate cleanouts: from $2,650 and up

## Services
- [Estate Cleanouts](https://www.vermontjunk.com/services/estate-cleanouts/): Full-property cleanouts for families, executors and realtors — handled with care and discretion.
- [Whole-House Cleanouts](https://www.vermontjunk.com/services/whole-house-cleanouts/): Moving, selling, or starting fresh — we empty the whole house in one booking.
- [Light Demolition](https://www.vermontjunk.com/services/demolition/): Sheds, decks, hot tubs, playsets and interior tear-outs — demo and haul-away in one job.
- [Construction & Renovation Debris](https://www.vermontjunk.com/services/construction-debris-removal/): C&D cleanup for contractors and DIY renovations — faster and cleaner than a dumpster.
- [Barn & Outbuilding Cleanouts](https://www.vermontjunk.com/services/barn-cleanouts/): Decades of stuff in the barn, shed or carriage house? We clear it all.
- [Basement Cleanouts](https://www.vermontjunk.com/services/basement-cleanouts/): Stairs, tight corners, decades of storage — we carry it all up and out.
- [Garage Cleanouts](https://www.vermontjunk.com/services/garage-cleanouts/): Get the car back in the garage. Most garages done in a single visit.
- [Vacation & Second-Home Cleanouts](https://www.vermontjunk.com/services/vacation-home-cleanouts/): Ski condos, rentals and second homes — cleared on your schedule, even when you're not here.
- [Real Estate & Property Manager Cleanouts](https://www.vermontjunk.com/services/real-estate-cleanouts/): Pre-listing, post-closing, foreclosure and rental turnovers for realtors and managers.
- [Commercial & Restaurant Equipment Removal](https://www.vermontjunk.com/services/commercial-junk-removal/): Walk-ins, commercial fridges, ovens and office cleanouts for local businesses.
- [Hot Tub Removal](https://www.vermontjunk.com/services/hot-tub-removal/): We cut up, haul and dispose of old hot tubs and spas — decks included if needed.
- [Shed Removal](https://www.vermontjunk.com/services/shed-removal/): Old, rotting or unwanted sheds torn down and hauled away in one visit.
- [Piano Removal](https://www.vermontjunk.com/services/piano-removal/): Uprights, spinets and organs — out of the house without wrecking the floors.
- [Appliance Removal](https://www.vermontjunk.com/services/appliance-removal/): Fridges, freezers, washers, dryers and stoves — hauled away and recycled.
- [Furniture Removal](https://www.vermontjunk.com/services/furniture-removal/): Sofas, sectionals, mattresses and bedroom sets — donated whenever possible.
- [Dump Trailer Rental](https://www.vermontjunk.com/services/dump-trailer-rental/): Doing it yourself? Rent a dump trailer — we drop it, haul it and handle the dump.
